device.soc: ALi M3511 (M3503 family rev B dual-CPU MIPS32 + SEE)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.2.0), MemCfg 0x01E800, maincode and SEE chunks -- 8 MB flash

simulator.note: Boots as M3503: initializes DDR3 memory controller, unpacks maincode and SEE, prints 'model = 25:HD506' and 'MC: APP  init ok'.

desc: The V1.09.12942 firmware update for the Opticum HD 506 8MB satellite receiver powered by the ALi M3511 SoC.
Features DDR3 memory controller initialization and dual-core MIPS32 + SEE architecture.
